scheme.bundle: JSON Lines: each entry of bundle_lines is one line without its newline; the bundle is every line followed by one newline; no line, its newline excluded, is longer than max_line_bytes
scheme.cases: receipt_keys and checkpoint_keys are the keys the verifier accepts; witness_lines are the lines of a witness file (docs/logs-chain.md, 'Witness files'), each without its newline: the receipts and checkpoints it holds independently of the exporter; report is what a bundle verifier must return
scheme.malformed: a bundle the verifier refuses; line is the number, from 1, of its first bad line
